setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays a four-step melody on the test device: trigs on steps 1 to 4 on pattern degrees 1 to 4 of scale slot 1 (C major), so MIDI 60, 62, 64 and 65. Global transposition is 0, the Song editor holds only slot 1, playback is stopped and the norns shows the Device page.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press Song (6,8) to open the Song editor. Hold slot 1 at (1,1) and press slot 2 at (2,1), then release both, and tap slot 2. Slot 2 is selected and bright, slot 1 is lit: slot 2 holds a copy of the melody.
steps.title: Copy slot 1 to slot 2

steps.caption: Press Scale (4,8). Press the left end of the transposition fader at (9,8) to set -12, then press (16,8) fourteen times to reach +2. The Scale overview shows Transpose +2 for this slot.
steps.title: Raise the copy by two semitones

steps.caption: Tap Play (1,8) and listen, then tap Play to stop. The copy loops D, E, F sharp, G: MIDI 62, 64, 66 and 67 in the strip below.
steps.title: Hear the copy

steps.caption: Press Song (6,8), tap slot 1 at (1,1) and tap Play (1,8). Slot 1 still loops C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65): the transposition belongs to the copy only. Tap Play to stop.
steps.title: Slot 1 keeps its pitches
